name: Garden Grove Unified School District
districtFact: Garden Grove Unified publishes districtwide school-year dates on its official calendar webpage. Minimum days, campus events, and program schedules may vary by school.
compareIntro: Compare GGUSD’s first day, Spring Recess, and last day with nearby Orange County and Southern California districts using each district’s reviewed calendar record.

districtFaqs.q: Does this calendar apply to every GGUSD school?
districtFaqs.a: The dates shown are districtwide. Individual schools may publish additional minimum days, campus events, testing schedules, or program dates.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families check for GGUSD calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Check GGUSD’s official school calendar webpage and your school’s announcements before relying on a saved or printed calendar.
